integrity: Originality assessed using inspected source statements and their logical coverage, with stated access risks; no independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Positive-integer strong divisibility sequences only; arbitrary integral generalized binomial arrays are not covered.
Different primes can have different minimizing interior columns.
The lcm-factor and Möbius formula are established earlier mathematics; the claimed connection to the unweighted generalized-binomial row gcd is the contribution.
The full 1991 and 1999 Ando-Sato chapters could not be inspected; implicit prior coverage remains possible.
Finite numerical checking does not replace the all-indices and all-sequences proof.
title: Universal row content of strong-divisibility binomial arrays
